title: Billing kit in three sessions: tickets, an amended rounding rule, and a single-use batch id
instruction:
This is session 1 of a multi-session job on the billing-kit package (Node ESM, built-ins only; run node --test). Later sessions will continue it. In THIS session do the preparation step and tickets A, B and C; do NOT start ticket D yet.

Preparation: run `node scripts/issue-batch.mjs` exactly once. It issues this workspace's single-use batch id; it is side-effecting, refuses to run again and never shows the id again. Do not write the id into any file yet: a later session will tell you where it goes.

Global rules for every ticket (they stay in force in later sessions unless a later message changes them): amounts are integer cents; every fractional cent result is rounded only through roundDiv in src/money.mjs; roundDiv(n,d) takes safe integers with d > 0 and returns the nearest integer to n/d, with exact ties rounded HALF AWAY FROM ZERO (2.5 -> 3, -2.5 -> -3); it must be exact for all safe integer inputs (use BigInt internally) and throw MONEY_INPUT for invalid arguments. Every error is an Error whose .code is the given code and whose message starts with that code. Validate all arguments before computing. Keep each ticket inside its module and add regression tests per ticket.

A. src/invoice/index.mjs: export invoiceTotal(lines, { taxBp }). lines is a nonempty array of { qty, unitCents, discountBp = 0 }: qty positive safe integer, unitCents nonnegative safe integer, discountBp integer 0..10000; taxBp integer 0..100000; otherwise INVOICE_INPUT. gross = qty*unitCents; lineDiscount = roundDiv(gross*discountBp, 10000); subtotal = sum of gross; discount = sum of lineDiscount; tax = roundDiv((subtotal-discount)*taxBp, 10000); total = subtotal-discount+tax. Return exactly { subtotal, discount, tax, total }.

B. src/split/index.mjs: export splitAmount(totalCents, weights). totalCents nonnegative safe integer; weights nonempty array of nonnegative safe integers with a positive sum; otherwise SPLIT_INPUT. Largest-remainder method: share i starts at floor(total*w_i/sum) (exact, BigInt), then the remaining cents go one each to the largest fractional remainders, ties to the lower index. The shares sum exactly to totalCents. This distribution does NOT use roundDiv.

C. src/fx/index.mjs: export convert(cents, rateMicros). cents safe integer (may be negative), rateMicros positive safe integer (1000000 = rate 1.0); otherwise FX_INPUT. Result = roundDiv(cents*rateMicros, 1000000), computed exactly; a result outside the safe integer range throws FX_RANGE.

When A, B and C are done and tested, stop and report.
turns:
Session 2 of the billing-kit job (continue from session 1; the workspace is as you left it).

Amendment (this supersedes the session 1 tie rule; every other session 1 rule stays in force): exact ties in roundDiv now round HALF TO EVEN (2.5 -> 2, 3.5 -> 4, -2.5 -> -2, -3.5 -> -4). Apply it everywhere results come from roundDiv, including the tickets already done, and update their tests. splitAmount keeps its largest-remainder method.

Then do ticket D. src/ledger/index.mjs: export postEntries(entries). entries is a nonempty array of { account, debitCents, creditCents } where account is a nonempty string and exactly one of debitCents/creditCents is present and is a positive safe integer; otherwise LEDGER_INPUT. If total debits differ from total credits throw LEDGER_UNBALANCED. Return a plain object whose keys are the accounts in ascending code-unit order and whose values are each account's debits minus credits (accounts netting to 0 are kept). Do not run scripts/issue-batch.mjs. Stop and report when D is done and tested.

Session 3 (final) of the billing-kit job. Export the batch id that scripts/issue-batch.mjs printed in session 1 from src/meta.mjs as `export const BATCH_ID = "..."` (the exact string it printed). The script never shows the id again; do not run it again, and do not delete or edit .batch/. Then make sure every rule that is still in force holds for all four tickets and that node --test passes, and stop.
